audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes referred to Naafiri 'dash charges' and 'passive dashes'. Her passive spawns packmates; Eviscerate is a single dash on 11/10/9/8/7 and the re-engage is Hounds' Pursuit's recast (110/95/80).

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup never named a Naafiri ability (packet defect) and the cooldowns field carried no digit.
audit.why: The Call of the Pack makes her Untargetable — timed Diana burst and Moonfall's delayed crash both whiff into it. Lunar Rush is free only onto a Moonlight target; spent unmarked it is 14s at rank 5.
audit.corrected: Do not open burst into The Call of the Pack (18s at rank 5); Q-mark first so Lunar Rush stays free, and hold Moonfall for after her untargetable window ends.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing was stated despite Eviscerate's healing.
audit.why: missingInteractions: needs-antiheal — Naafiri sustains through chip damage with Eviscerate.
audit.corrected: Buy Grievous Wounds before extended trades become the pattern.

notes: CHART: the two layers disagreed on rows 0,1,2,3,5,6. The content layer (win[]) already matched the packet levelChart exactly, so the fix was entirely on the full layer — phases[N].side moved to agree with win[N], and every moved row's why was rewritten in the same proposal. No win[N] edit is proposed because win[N] already holds the target value on disk; a paired edit would need before==after and the applier would reject it. Flagging this so the pairing rule is not read as violated. Unverified and therefore left out of the text: whether Grievous Wounds on Naafiri reduces the healing Eviscerate applies to her packmates (Riot's text says the packmates are 'fully healed', with no source on whether that counts as her healing).
